_note: SCHEMA EXAMPLE ONLY — THIS FILE IS NOT EVIDENCE.
Its kind is deliberately not 'gksa14-e2e-capture', so tests/e2e/verify.py
rejects it as an unsupported schema. Do not treat this file as a passing
capture; the validator never generates a capture and never marks a scenario
passed.
This file exists so the negative check can prove that an unexecuted example
is rejected instead of silently accepted.
The two failure categories are state-read (gksr.status.reminderUnavailable)
and corner-hud (gksr.status.hudUnavailable); the check-mark icon failure is
part of the corner-hud category, not a separate category.
The native notice is a titleless, iconless, non-blocking plain-text
notification with native lifetime and auto-dismiss; it never pauses the game
or captures input.
At most one actually displayed notice per category per load; a failed show
logs only and never consumes eligibility; a queued notice is cleared if the
fault recovers before display or the load ends; recovery adds no success
message.
observationVocabulary keys are an evidence schema, not a mandatory production
telemetry API; real facts may be collected by operator observation, logs, or an
authorized future test facility.
Every visual scenario requires a screenshot plus a measurement or an
explicit operatorObservation.
